title: 4 of 15 claims are MOCKED with no code backing — TEE, x402, real-time monitoring, crypto snapshot
evidence: C1 'TEE-bound agent': hardcoded 'ATTESTATION: 0x7f3a...b91e' text, zero TEE code. C2 'x402 micropayments': PaymentButton uses setTimeout, no network request, 'Simulate Payment' label. C3 'real-time whale monitoring': static comparison.json. C13 'crypto snapshot': proof page shows static text. All 4 acknowledged as MOCKED in ARCHITECTURE.md Emergency Mode table. The remaining 11 claims are REAL (8) or PARTIAL (2) or EXTERNAL (1).
rationale: These are documented as emergency-mode mocks in the PRD and ARCHITECTURE.md. The demo has a 'Demo Mode — Pre-computed Data' badge. The mocks are transparent. Severity P1 (qualitative cap) because the project is honest about its demo limitations.
fix_guidance: Replace 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED' badge with 'Simulated TEE Attestation'. Add '(Demo Mode)' suffix to x402 payment. Document all mocks in submission description.

title: Transaction count mismatch — stats bar says 6,134, README says 4,463
evidence: page.tsx stats bar: '6,134 TRANSACTIONS' hardcoded in JSX. README.md and PRD.md: 4,463 transactions across 3 chains. The stats bar number appears to be aspirational or from a different data set. The actual cache data (3 wallet JSON files) should be the source of truth.
rationale: Low impact — judges unlikely to cross-reference. But if a judge calculates from the demo data and gets a different number, this undermines trust.
fix_guidance: Make the stats bar number dynamic — compute from cache data at render time. Or align with README at 4,463.

title: 33/33 Playwright tests verified — stress-test report confirms 100% pass
evidence: STRESS-TEST-REPORT.md confirms 33/33 Playwright browser tests passed. stress-browser.spec.ts exists. Pipeline log confirms stress_test completed at 95/100 confidence. What tests verify: 6-phase state machine, responsive layout (320px+1440px), keyboard navigation, network resilience, visual design compliance.
rationale: The '33/33 tests' claim is verified by the stress test report. Covers the full demo flow. Solid evidence.
fix_guidance: No action needed. Consider adding unit tests for classifier.ts and persona.ts for additional coverage.

title: TEE, x402, and 'real-time' claims are UI-only with zero implementation code
location: ARCHITECTURE.md Emergency Mode Table; src/components/PaymentButton.tsx; src/app/page.tsx
evidence: TEE attestation: static badge, no SGX/TDX SDK, no remote attestation protocol. x402: setTimeout animation, no USDC transfer, no payment protocol. Real-time monitoring: pre-cached JSON, no WebSocket, no polling. All documented as [MOCK] in the Emergency Mode table. Zero TODO/commented-out implementation — the code simply doesn't exist for these features.
rationale: The project is transparent about mock status. The 'TEE-sealed' language is aspirational marketing. Not malicious — it's hackathon time pressure. But 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED' is a stronger claim than 'Simulated TEE Attestation'.
fix_guidance: Align language: 'TEE-sealed' → 'TEE-ready architecture', 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED' → 'Simulated Attestation (Demo)', 'Real-time' → 'Pre-computed (Demo)'. Document in submission FAQ.

title: OKX integrations are import-level or bypassed — no live OKX code executes in demo
evidence: All 4 claimed OKX integrations: (1) Wallet — OnchainOS CLI functions exist but cacheExists() bypasses them. (2) DEX Market — leaderboard/portfolio-overview CLI commands exist but never called in demo. (3) OKX AI Marketplace — ASP listing is external, ERC-8004 badge is static text. (4) x402 — completely mocked. Zero OKX npm packages in package.json. The OnchainOS 'SDK' is a shell-wrapper around a CLI binary not present on Vercel.
rationale: The integration architecture is correct — the OnchainOS CLI wrappers would work if the binary were installed and cache didn't short-circuit. But in the submitted demo, zero OKX code executes. This is the biggest claim-reality gap: the project claims OKX integration but serves static JSON.
fix_guidance: For hackathon: add curl-based OKX REST API calls (using OKX_API_KEY from env) instead of CLI. Remove cacheExists() short-circuit in production. For demo mode: document that integrations are 'wired but bypassed for deterministic demo experience.'
